name: election-backend
description: Reference election backend for the CMU CAMT automated testing workshop

scripts.db:migrate: docker compose run --rm --build -e LIQUIBASE_COMMAND_URL=jdbc:postgresql://db:5432/election_dev -e LIQUIBASE_COMMAND_CONTEXTS=dev liquibase update
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: npm run db:up:test && npm run db:migrate:test && jest --selectProjects integration --runInBand
scripts.db:migrate:e2e: docker compose run --rm --build -e LIQUIBASE_COMMAND_URL=jdbc:postgresql://db-e2e:5432/election_e2e -e LIQUIBASE_COMMAND_CONTEXTS=e2e liquibase update
scripts.test:e2e: npm run db:up:e2e && npm run db:migrate:e2e && docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate --wait app && playwright test
